correctness.rationale: PASS: The restricted quadratic form in a central plane has eccentricity squared equal to its eigenvalue gap divided by the larger restricted eigenvalue. There are exactly four oriented circular-section normals at (±sqrt((β-α)/(γ-α)),0,±sqrt((γ-β)/(γ-α))); linearizing the gap in two tangent coordinates yields radial slope 2sqrt((β-α)(γ-β))/β. Four disks of radius (β/[2sqrt((β-α)(γ-β))])ε² give Cε⁴. Min–max gives M=1-α/γ; explicit perfect-square identity yields the sharp bound and involution β→αγβ/((α+γ)β-αγ). Exact rational check of (1,2,4) vs (1,4/3,4) gives M=3/4,C=1/2; spheroid formulas follow from uniform directional cosine. Fixed triaxial shape only; no uniform gap-merger claim.
